video_title: Did the New York Knicks WIN the NBA Championship because of their chemistry?! | Get Up

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' historic postseason point differential and comeback ability
quotes.excerpt: Every time they got a chance to close out, they didn't just win, they did psychological damage.
quotes.quote: They were underdogs going into the finals and they were some of the greatest playing from behind because they were behind in all of these games and they made these incredible comebacks and they were also absolute killers in closeout games. Every time they got a chance to close out, they didn't just win, they did psychological damage to their opponent. Truly one of the great playoff runs we have seen in the modern era.

quotes.speaker: Jay Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' ability to win close games on the road
quotes.excerpt: Every NBA Finals game you are down double digits and you find a way to walk them.
quotes.quote: Every NBA Finals game you are down double digits and you find a way to walk them down the street and win the game down the stretch to win the finals, Game 5 in San Antonio where your star player has a 45-point closeout game, spectacular. You can say they may not beat Kevin Durant and Stephen Curry and Klay Thompson, but today, I don't give a damn. They don't matter. They don't have to play them.

quotes.speaker: Mike Greenberg
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' dominance in road closeout games
quotes.excerpt: Seven and two in the last four years in road closeout games. That's what this team is.

text_blocks.speaker: Mike Greenberg
text_blocks.text: Seven and two in the last four years in road closeout games. That's what this team is always about. Four and zero in closeout games here as the music is playing out. I love that.

quotes.speaker: Monica McNutt
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown's impact on the Knicks' championship run
quotes.excerpt: We have yet to even talk about Mike Brown coming into a job where this was the expectation.
quotes.quote: We have yet to even talk about Mike Brown coming into a job where this was the expectation. All of it coming together in the way that it did, there is a number of stories that we can dig into, but truly, it is going to point back to Brunson's willingness to take on all of the pressure of New York and be sort of that cornerstone that they built around.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Leon Rose's vision and recruitment of Villanova players
quotes.excerpt: Jim Dolan said I need an agent to find me players. He hired Leon Rose.
quotes.quote: Jim Dolan said I need an agent to find me players. He hired Leon Rose. That took courage and conviction. Leon Rose is from the South Jersey area, loved the Villanova teams that he watched win championships, recruited those players, signed some of them. He said I am going to get some of those Villanova players to win in the NBA and I am going to start with Jalen Brunson. He went out and found players not only that he had represented, that he knew like Karl-Anthony Towns and OG Anunoby that other teams didn't want to pay.

quotes.speaker: Mike Greenberg
quotes.excerpt: If you and I work together and we have no chemistry, then what we produce will be equal.
quotes.quote: If you and I work together and we have no chemistry, then what we produce will be equal to greeny plus Jay. It's a mathematical equation. If we do have chemistry, then what we produce will be equal to greeny times Jay. I make you better and you make me better. You can't usually predict when people are going to have chemistry, but in this case you could, because they put together three guys from college who love each other and everyone knew that going in.

quotes.speaker: Mike Greenberg
quotes.summary_phrase: San Antonio Spurs' future chemistry and development challenges
quotes.excerpt: Dylan Harper had great first halves and would fizzle out in the second half like a young player.
quotes.quote: Dylan Harper had great first halves and would fizzle out in the second half like a young player might do. And he and the De'Aaron Fox dynamic, that's something the Spurs are going to have to figure out for sure. But those three guys, Harper, Castle, and Victor Wembanyama for a long time are going to terrorize the West.
